root_cause: The validation workflow asserted train_dates and calibration_dates in MODEL_CONTRACT.json, but the immutable evaluator records chronological date roles in RESULT.json under model.train_dates and model.calibration_dates. MODEL_CONTRACT.json intentionally records only model architecture, features and decision-rule identity.
correction: Read the two chronological date arrays from RESULT.json:model instead of MODEL_CONTRACT.json. No source, feature, label, model, calibration, probability, action, execution, cost, risk, account path, gate or sealed-period rule changes.
